# Nilos Bay

> Nile-side dining and lifestyle mall in Dokki, Giza — 9 cafes, restaurants, bowling and Nile boat rides, open 24/7.

Nilos Bay sits on the Nile in Dokki, Giza. It hosts independent cafes (Kim's Coffee, Second Cup), restaurants (Wardah, Nilerra, Darnoura, Uncle Zack), a mocktail bar (Mokhito), In Lane Bowling, and Abaza Boats for private Nile rides. Address: 26J9+CFQ, Ad Doqi A, Dokki, Giza Governorate. Phone / WhatsApp: +20 10 6401 1110.

## Venues

- **Mokhito** — Mocktails & Bites. Signature mojitos, fresh mocktails and laid-back Nile-side bites. Instagram: @mokhitoeg
- **Wardah** — Restaurant. Modern Egyptian dining with a fresh, floral twist on classics. Instagram: @wardah_eg
- **Kim's Coffee** — Specialty Coffee. Hand-crafted specialty brews and cozy corners by the river. Instagram: @kimscoffeeegy
- **Second Cup** — Café. Your favorite Canadian coffeehouse — espresso, lattes & sweet treats. Instagram: @secondcupegypt
- **Nilerra** — Restaurant. Mediterranean plates and grills with a sweeping Nile view. Instagram: @nilerra_resturant
- **Darnoura** — Restaurant. Authentic Levantine flavors — mezze, grills and warm hospitality. Instagram: @darnoura.eg
- **Uncle Zack** — Burgers & Comfort. Smashed burgers, loaded fries and feel-good comfort food. Instagram: @uncle.zack.eg
- **In Lane Bowling** — Bowling & Entertainment. Roll a few frames Nile-side — perfect for friends, dates and groups. Instagram: @inlanebowlingnilos
- **Abaza Boats** — Nile Boat Rides. Step from the bay onto the river — private boat rides on the Nile. Instagram: @abaza_boats
